items.explanation: Animals in the plural: the accusative is the same as the nominative, koty.
optionNotes: -ów is for men (studentów), not for animals.

items.explanation: Men as objects take -ów, and "these" is tych.
optionNotes: Studenty does not exist; for men use the masculine personal forms.
This is the nominative: the subject form.
The noun must change too: studentów.

items.explanation: Rodzice is masculine personal, so the accusative is rodziców.
optionNotes: Rodzice is the nominative; the object form is rodziców.
Not a word: the ending is -ów.

items.explanation: Books are things: the accusative plural is the same as the nominative, polskie książki.
optionNotes: This is the genitive plural (dużo polskich książek).
The adjective -ich is only for men here.
